name: reverse-len-not-multiple-of-8
meaning: 0x15 PATH_REF_REVERSE carries 0x14's body grammar exactly (RFC-0024 §7.1 amendment 2), so length=12 — one and a half elements — has no reading and is tr::frame::invalid for the identical reason path-ref/ref-len-not-multiple-of-8 is. A successful decode of this frame is a conformance FAILURE.
